title: Planning Budget Mode
description: Whether the buyer fixes the budget of a plan or asks the seller to suggest one. Distinct from budget_allocation.mode, which says how an executed total budget is split across packages (fixed or seller_optimized); budget_mode says where the total comes from. When absent, a request with a budget_range means set and one without means suggest.

enumDescriptions.set: The buyer states the budget (criteria.offer_filters.budget_range). The seller plans within it and reports, per goal, whether the plan meets it. Requires a budget_range; a request without one is rejected with INVALID_REQUEST naming criteria.planning_goals.budget_mode.
enumDescriptions.suggest: The seller sizes the budget to the other planning goals (a delivery_target, an objective, a max_frequency) and states it in commercial_terms.total_budget and total_budget_guidance. A budget_range, when present, bounds the suggestion.
